# @goliapkg/gds

> GOLIA Design System — enterprise-grade React UI component library with 370+ components, contextual depth, glass materials, and AI-native structure. Built by GOLIA for all company React web applications.

## Quick Reference

- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): complete component API, patterns, and usage examples
- [Component Index](src/index.ts): all public exports
- [Design Tokens](src/l0-tokens/): CSS variables, color math, sizing, motion, glass, gestures
- [Theme System](src/l1-systems/): Jotai-based 5-axis theme engine
- [Dependency Manifest](src/l0-tokens/deps.ts): all external deps with layer constraints
- [Design Principles](/.claude/rules/gds-philosophy.md): 10 governing principles
- [Library Standards](/.claude/rules/gds-lib.md): coding standards for components

## Architecture

8-layer system with strict upward-only dependency flow:

- L0 Tokens: CSS variables, color derivation, scales, motion, glass, gestures
- L1 Systems: Theme engine (Jotai atoms), hooks, state management
- L2 Primitives (~30): Stateless visual blocks — Button, Input, Badge, Spinner...
- L3 Atoms (~60): Simple composed — Avatar, Checkbox, Tooltip, Switch, Rating...
- L4 Molecules (~70): Multi-part — Card, Dialog, Tabs, Select, Dropdown, Sheet...
- L5 Organisms (~60): Complex — DataTable, Calendar, Kanban, FileBrowser, Tree...
- L6 Charts (31): Recharts-based — Bar, Line, Heatmap, Sankey, Treemap, Gauge...
- L7 Patterns (~55): Page layouts — Dashboard, Admin, Settings, Login, Sidebar...
- Utils: Anti-corruption layer — cx(), focusCls, VariantProps, dom, glass, motion

## Component Pattern

Every component follows: CVA variants → typed Props → forwardRef → cx() merging → data-* attributes

## Key Props (available on most components)

- glass?: boolean — frosted translucency material
- motion?: string — animation preset (fade, scale, slide, spring)
- variant — visual style variant (via CVA)
- size — size variant (sm, default, lg)
- className — consumer override (merged via cx)

## Styling System

- Semantic tokens only (never raw Tailwind colors)
- Contextual depth: gds-ctx class auto-scales spacing/radius/shadow/text per nesting level
- Depth utilities: gds-pad, gds-gap, gds-radius, gds-shadow, gds-text, gds-heading

## Tech Stack

React 19, TypeScript 5 (strict), Tailwind CSS 4, CVA, Jotai, Recharts 3, Lucide, Vite 8
